title: AI-Powered Customer Support Platform
excerpt: Built an intelligent customer support platform that reduced response times by 60% using AI-powered ticket classification and auto-responses.
problem: A growing SaaS company was struggling with an overwhelming volume of customer support tickets. Their team of 5 support agents couldn't keep up with 500+ daily tickets, leading to 48-hour average response times and declining customer satisfaction scores.
solution: Developed an AI-powered support platform that automatically classifies incoming tickets by urgency and category, generates suggested responses using OpenAI's GPT-4, and routes complex issues to the right specialist. Integrated with their existing Slack workspace for real-time notifications and built a custom dashboard for analytics.

title: Multi-Tenant SaaS Analytics Dashboard
excerpt: Designed and built a multi-tenant analytics dashboard serving 10,000+ users with real-time data visualization and role-based access control.
problem: A fintech startup needed a scalable analytics platform that could serve multiple enterprise clients, each with their own data isolation, custom dashboards, and user management. Their existing solution was a monolithic app that couldn't scale beyond 100 concurrent users.
solution: Architected a multi-tenant SaaS platform using Next.js for server-rendered dashboards, Node.js microservices for data processing, and MongoDB with tenant-scoped data isolation. Implemented real-time WebSocket updates, advanced charting with D3.js, and a role-based permission system supporting admin, manager, and viewer roles.

title: E-Commerce Platform with AI Recommendations
excerpt: Built a high-performance e-commerce platform with AI-powered product recommendations that increased average order value by 32%.
problem: An online retailer with 50,000+ SKUs was losing sales due to poor product discovery. Their existing platform had no personalization, slow search, and a clunky checkout process that resulted in a 78% cart abandonment rate.
solution: Rebuilt the entire e-commerce frontend using React with server-side rendering via Next.js for SEO. Implemented AI-powered product recommendations using collaborative filtering, built an Elasticsearch-powered search with autocomplete, and designed a streamlined 2-step checkout with Stripe integration. Added real-time inventory tracking and automated email sequences.

title: Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) System
excerpt: Developed a comprehensive ERP system with inventory management, HR modules, and financial reporting for a manufacturing company.
problem: A mid-size manufacturing company was managing operations across 5 departments using spreadsheets and disconnected tools. This led to data inconsistencies, delayed reporting, and an inability to make real-time business decisions.
solution: Designed and built a comprehensive ERP system using Angular for the frontend with a modular architecture, Node.js microservices for the backend, and MongoDB for flexible data storage. Modules included inventory management with barcode scanning, HR with payroll integration, financial reporting with automated reconciliation, and a real-time executive dashboard.

title: Real-Time Collaboration Tool
excerpt: Created a real-time collaboration platform with live document editing, video conferencing integration, and project management features.
problem: A remote-first startup with 200+ team members across 12 countries needed a unified collaboration tool. They were paying for 8 different subscriptions (Notion, Slack, Zoom, Jira, etc.) totaling $45,000/month, and data was siloed across platforms.
solution: Built a unified collaboration platform with real-time document editing using CRDTs (Conflict-free Replicated Data Types), integrated video calling via WebRTC, kanban project boards, and a team chat system. Used a microservices architecture with event-driven communication for scalability.
